note: Vendor tip: police nearby (context = hint kind: post, search, roadblock, stakeout, car). {where} = a street or corner. Adults only. Gameplay emits the key with the text (b69b367).

lines.text: Two blues on the {where} corner. Been there since lunch.
Cop on {where}. He buys a frank every day and watches everybody.
They're stopping people on {where}. Patting down, asking names.
Plainclothes on {where}. Shoes too shiny for this block.
Sawhorses on {where}. Every car gets a look.
They closed {where}. Said it's a water main. Water mains don't carry shotguns.
Car parked on {where} three hours. Two men, no newspaper. That's cops.
Somebody's watching {where} from a window. Curtains don't move like that.
Radio car cruising {where}. Slow. Real slow.
Unmarked sedan, {where}. Antenna on the trunk. Who are they kidding?
